author: Slidebean
description:
Why the DeepMind Boston Dynamics partnership changes industrial automation.

By integrating advanced Gemini AI into humanoid robots designed for factory environments, Google DeepMind and Boston Dynamics are pushing autonomy from software into physical labor.

This shift represents more than automation efficiency, it introduces AI decision making directly onto the factory floor.
The future of work may not just be automated.
It may be autonomous by design.

title: Boston Dynamics just gave its robots Google’s brain.
